release_summary: Export saved playlists directly, keep your Studio edits safe, and get clearer, more reliable DJ exports.

release_features.title: Export From Playlists
release_features.brief: Send a saved set straight to Serato or djay Pro.
release_features.description: Choose Export on a saved playlist, pick your DJ software and keep its name and saved song order. Your current Studio set stays untouched.

release_features.title: djay Export Compatibility
release_features.brief: Read more native playlist records safely.
release_features.description: Improved native playlist decoding and shared-folder handling retain existing djay data. Unsupported records stop safely with a complete, copyable explanation.

release_features.title: Your Studio Edits Stay Yours
release_features.brief: Late Magic Set results cannot replace newer work.
release_features.description: Changing or clearing your set, curve, anchor or brief while a build is running preserves those changes. Repeated build clicks are guarded and failed requests can be retried.

release_features.title: Verified Playlist Saves
release_features.brief: Confirm the songs and their order were saved.
release_features.description: AXIOM checks the complete stored playlist and protects unreadable saved data from being replaced. Genuine storage problems explain how to keep a backup.

release_features.title: Clearer Export Results
release_features.brief: See what was delivered and what needs attention.
release_features.description: Export receipts include tracks missing from djay. A report-file problem no longer labels an already verified playlist export as failed. Serato is checked again before committing an export.

release_features.title: Exact Build In Settings
release_features.brief: Identify the installed release and build.
release_features.description: Settings displays AXIOM PRO 1.0.4.2 and its exact build number. Checking for updates keeps the installed identity separate from the available release.

release_business.title: 30 Days Free
release_business.brief: Every engine is available during your trial. No card is needed to start.
release_business.description: Your 30-day trial begins when AXIOM PRO accepts your DJ OWE account activation. Downloading or activating does not start a subscription or an automatic charge.

release_business.title: One Subscription
release_business.brief: Every engine is included while your AXIOM PRO subscription is active.
release_business.description: Monthly and annual AXIOM PRO subscriptions include Studio DAW, Performance, Health, and Magic Set + Paste a Playlist while active. This is separate from DJ OWE Record Pool Core Members.

release_business.title: Own Your Engines
release_business.brief: An engine you buy remains usable without a subscription.
release_business.description: Buy a single engine or the Complete Toolkit to keep using the included tools after a subscription ends. Ownership includes the library, project, save, and export functions required for those tools. Other engines remain locked unless you subscribe or own them.

release_business.title: Your Work Stays Yours
release_business.brief: Your library, saved sets, and DAW projects are preserved.
release_business.description: A trial or subscription ending does not delete your work. You can review and restore access through your DJ OWE account.

release_closing: AXIOM PRO for Apple Silicon. Your existing music, playlists and projects stay in place.

previous_release_features.title: djay Export Compatibility
previous_release_features.brief: Read more supported playlist encodings.
previous_release_features.description: Exports accept additional native djay playlist encodings while preserving existing playlist data. Unrecognized structures stop safely before writing.

previous_release_features.title: Serato Library Recovery
previous_release_features.brief: Recover readable database records.
previous_release_features.description: Connecting database V2 retains valid records when optional text is damaged and reports unreadable entries. You can connect Serato before choosing a music folder.

previous_release_features.title: Original Playlist Folders
previous_release_features.brief: Keep the names and nesting from djay.
previous_release_features.description: djay-to-Serato transfers preserve original folder and playlist names, hierarchy and song order. New transfers no longer flatten paths into crate titles or add visible identity hashes.

previous_release_features.title: Faster Live Assistant
previous_release_features.brief: Songs and playlists arrive sooner.
previous_release_features.description: Reuse library and playlist reads, load selected playlist tracks efficiently, and deliver completed recommendations promptly to the floating Assistant.

previous_release_features.title: Steady Song Suggestions
previous_release_features.brief: One recognised version of each song.
previous_release_features.description: Duplicate updates do not redraw an unchanged list. Alternate edits cannot return as filler or appear again when playlist and regular recommendations are combined.

previous_release_features.title: Played Songs Stay in Their Session
previous_release_features.brief: Reset Session starts fresh.
previous_release_features.description: Played songs and recognised versions remain excluded through refreshes and reopening. Reset clears those exclusions and rejects late updates and history from the ended session.

previous_release_features.title: Smoother Assistant Opening
previous_release_features.brief: Choose corner tab or open panel.
previous_release_features.description: The Assistant prepares its layout before a short entrance animation. Controls lets you choose whether it starts as the corner tab or the open panel, with fully readable labels at compact sizes.

previous_release_features.title: Reliable Playlist Transfers
previous_release_features.brief: Visible progress and recoverable results.
previous_release_features.description: djay-to-Serato transfers use the guarded modern-library path. Background jobs keep progress and receipts through slow or lost responses, with duplicate delivery checks and clear failures.

previous_release_features.title: Health Recovery
previous_release_features.brief: Keep track of scans and repairs.
previous_release_features.description: Health reconnects to existing scan and publishing jobs after a lost response, blocks duplicate submissions while status is unresolved, and keeps previous cleanup findings when a new request fails.

previous_release_features.title: Transfer Playlists Directly
previous_release_features.brief: Choose playlists, then Transfer now.
previous_release_features.description: Serato and djay playlist transfer uses one selection screen with visible action buttons, working animation, delivery totals and clear errors. Required file-location confirmation and duplicate-transfer protection remain.

previous_release_features.title: Connected Year Preparation
previous_release_features.brief: Library and Health share saved year results and retry busy services.
previous_release_features.description: Completed lookups are reused across Library and Health. Authorized pending lookups retry with bounded attempts after provider cooldowns, and can be stopped. Estimates and era-only values stay labelled; original music tags remain unchanged. Compact receipts keep View All Tracks and Stop Retries fully readable.

previous_release_features.title: Reliable Stem Playback
previous_release_features.brief: Keep edited clips playing and stems aligned.
previous_release_features.description: Ready stems reuse verified audio. Split, move and trim keep stem timing together, and unavailable clip audio no longer stops the whole project.

previous_release_features.title: AXIOM Tape Stop
previous_release_features.brief: Slow, stop or loop audio in your chosen bars.
previous_release_features.description: Classic, Modern and Loop modes support clip, layer or mix routing, speed automation and the existing export workflow.

previous_release_features.title: Stutter and Build
previous_release_features.brief: Repeat a slice or raise the energy with one control.
previous_release_features.description: Stutter repeats the opening slice. Build combines bass filtering, echo and room with automation and saved presets.

previous_release_features.title: Warmth and Crunch
previous_release_features.brief: Add saturation or a rougher digital sound.
previous_release_features.description: Two built-in effects use the same clip, layer and mix routing for playback and export.

previous_release_features.title: Vocal Chop Pads
previous_release_features.brief: Turn a short clip or ready vocal stem into playable pads.
previous_release_features.description: Chop up to 16 seconds into 2–16 slices without replacing existing pad sounds or patterns.

previous_release_features.title: Freeze and Beat Correction
previous_release_features.brief: Lighten playback and correct a beat while keeping stems together.
previous_release_features.description: Freeze up to two minutes into an AXIOM-owned render, then Unfreeze to restore source settings. Pin neighbouring beats when correcting timing.

previous_release_features.title: Faster Health Repairs
previous_release_features.brief: Save fast batches efficiently and recover completed era results.
previous_release_features.description: Health combines rapid save checkpoints, reuses unchanged fallback key audio and respects busy year services. Era fixes recover a saved result after a lost response; original music tags remain unchanged.

previous_release_features.title: Readable DAW Dialogs
previous_release_features.brief: Clear titles and controls in Day Mode.
previous_release_features.description: DAW effect and creative-tool dialogs keep readable headings and buttons in Day Mode, including focused and disabled controls.

previous_release_features.title: Rust Analysis Reporting
previous_release_features.brief: See which analysis engine did the work.
previous_release_features.description: Health shows Rust DSP work separately from shared audio preparation and true fallbacks. Analysis results are unchanged.

previous_release_features.title: Readable Health Receipts
previous_release_features.brief: Read your session progress in Day mode.
previous_release_features.description: Health session receipts stay readable in Day mode, including empty sessions and completed work.

previous_release_features.title: Cleanup Review Recovery
previous_release_features.brief: Refresh an outdated preview and review it again.
previous_release_features.description: Title and artist cleanup offers Refresh review when a preview is outdated. Completed reviews stop showing permanent working status. Refreshed suggestions still require confirmation before applying.

previous_release_features.title: Keep Your Working Set
previous_release_features.brief: Your edits survive a slow request.
previous_release_features.description: Magic Set and Suggest Order preserve changes made while a request is running. Loading a backup creates its own saved set and clears the previous route.

previous_release_features.title: Reliable Favorites and Venue Saves
previous_release_features.brief: Save failures are visible, and saved changes are protected.
previous_release_features.description: Favorites report unsuccessful saves and retain the previous confirmed list. Legacy Favorites stay recoverable until migration is verified. Simultaneous venue and roster saves preserve both changes.

previous_release_features.title: Safe Track Names
previous_release_features.brief: Unusual track names display safely.
previous_release_features.description: Studio treats quotes and markup characters in track metadata as literal text, preserving Edit and Preview controls.

previous_release_features.title: Stronger Cue Publishing Checks
previous_release_features.brief: Extra verification protects your music.
previous_release_features.description: Serato cue publishing checks the encoded audio payload before replacement, retains verification in its receipt and rejects rollback when the audio has changed.

previous_release_features.title: Live Assist Tempo Recovery
previous_release_features.brief: Suggestions follow the current deck tempo.
previous_release_features.description: Missing-artist tracks require a unique exact match. Live Assist withholds stale recommendations while tempo is unavailable and resumes suggestions when the tempo returns.

previous_release_features.title: Smaller Live Assist layouts
previous_release_features.brief: Fit more songs with a saved sizing slider.
previous_release_features.description: Adjust track text and row spacing together with a saved 60–100% slider. Small preferences migrate to Compact. The floating panel prepares its final layout before appearing without an animated stretch. Bottom-right minimize is preserved.

previous_release_features.title: More Like This follows your song
previous_release_features.brief: Same artist first, matching genre and a 2, 5 or 10-year lookback.
previous_release_features.description: Move older or newer using minus and plus. Matching genre stays first; two or fewer eligible genre songs allow root-family alternatives. Saved year corrections are used automatically; conflicting remix tags are not shown as confirmed original years.

previous_release_features.title: Find Original Years
previous_release_features.brief: Research a group, folder, genre or remixer.
previous_release_features.description: Fix Eras groups songs for reliable timeline placement. Original-year research inspects exact song/artist and official release evidence. Verified corrections save to AXIOM with read-back and completion totals. Uncertain matches stay in review; file publishing remains separate.

previous_release_features.title: Year cleanup remembers what needs help
previous_release_features.brief: Review updated songs and pause repeated failed lookups.
previous_release_features.description: Completion shows updated, already correct and review counts before opening the receipt. Repeated unresolved research is held with attempt counts and reasons until explicit retry. Saved years survive generated-cache cleanup and serve future Live Assist sessions. Performance offers an optional Health preparation reminder.

previous_release_features.title: Steadier Create Stems progress
previous_release_features.brief: Keep the button, waveform and focus in place.
previous_release_features.description: Progress polling updates status fields without rebuilding inspector or context controls. Existing processing, cancellation and audio behavior are preserved.

previous_release_features.title: Live Assist Steel Design
previous_release_features.brief: Cleaner controls, crates and recording setup.
previous_release_features.description: The approved AXIOM PRO layout includes steel Controls, More Like This and Record panels, a readable unified footer, DJ software track placement at the top or bottom, and a real input decibel meter. Selected Playing Now badges leave the DJ software logo clear. Lime controls use dark text; steel controls use light text. Maybe Next becomes the chosen crowd-mood emoji, remembers it on this Mac, and retains the saved-request count. Selected steel tempo and feedback controls cancel the legacy blackening filter and retain readable white labels.

previous_release_features.title: Quiet Coach
previous_release_features.brief: Familiar pairings, discoveries and set reminders beside Live Assist.
previous_release_features.description: Coach messages use the approved steel track cards and opaque compact popup. Familiar pairing, Discovery and this set reminder retain their existing local rules and timers. The sample preview is restricted to local source review.

previous_release_features.title: Bottom-right Minimized Assist
previous_release_features.brief: The activation bar stays in the corner above the Dock.
previous_release_features.description: Minimizing Live Assist collapses to the bottom-right of the current screen visible frame. Permission waiting and reconnection use a dedicated compact row.

previous_release_features.title: Desktop CSV Import
previous_release_features.brief: Choose a DJ performance CSV directly from your Mac.
previous_release_features.description: Studio uses a dedicated native CSV picker, reads the selected file inside the desktop app, and imports its contents without requesting a music-folder path. CSV cancellation stays cancelled. Path imports accept quoted, escaped and file-URL paths; blocked reads explain how to recover. The Record Vault import panel shows linked and unlinked track totals before opening the performance in Studio.

previous_release_features.title: Upgraded Playlists
previous_release_features.brief: Save, rename and refine sets in the new Record Vault style.
previous_release_features.description: Saved-set cards, album artwork, Name Your Set, Rename and completion panels share the approved handoff design. Existing editing, playback, import and Undo deletion behavior remain. Day Mode retains readable selected labels.

previous_release_features.title: Safer Broadcast Installation
previous_release_features.brief: Upgrade the driver without interrupting system audio.
previous_release_features.description: Identical drivers are retained. New drivers are staged and verified before replacement; failed replacement restores the previous driver and reports failure. Installation does not restart system audio. A new driver may need a normal Mac restart after audio work is finished. macOS 12 explains the DJ Software Audio limit before recording and offers Controller / Interface.

previous_release_features.title: Mac Mini DAW Playhead
previous_release_features.brief: Playback position advances on older native WebKit.
previous_release_features.description: AXIOM rejects malformed output timestamps and follows its latency-adjusted audio clock. Pause, seeking, resumed playback and looping retain their existing behavior.

previous_release_features.title: Serato Library Compatibility
previous_release_features.brief: Crate export supports both known membership schemas.
previous_release_features.description: Serato crate exports use the destination membership schema without adding a revision column. Existing backup, read-back and rollback checks remain. Unknown schemas stop safely.

previous_release_features.title: Faster Studio Matching
previous_release_features.brief: Get matching songs without checking every unrelated song family.
previous_release_features.description: Tempo, key and energy filters run before duplicate normalization. Matching order and played-song exclusions remain intact. Add to Set paints immediately while cue discovery and scoring finish.

previous_release_features.title: Magic Set Song Markers
previous_release_features.brief: Your working set stays visible on the grid.
previous_release_features.description: Manually added tracks and newly generated sets update their song markers immediately, even while the audit is pending or fails. Draft points and selected anchors remain separate.

previous_release_features.title: List and Album Art Views
previous_release_features.brief: Choose how you browse your music.
previous_release_features.description: The redesigned Pro Library keeps the original black finish and existing preparation controls. Switch between List and Album Art, with 40 tracks at a time and Show More.

previous_release_features.title: Library Column Sorting
previous_release_features.brief: Click a heading; Ctrl-click to add another sort.
previous_release_features.description: Sort the full library by Track, Genre, Year, BPM or Key. Click again to reverse direction; Ctrl-click or Command-click adds secondary ordering. Missing metadata stays last. Matching Songs starts off in Library only; Studio matching remains available.

previous_release_features.title: Cleaner Desktop Upgrades
previous_release_features.brief: Current PRO and LITE files only.
previous_release_features.description: The installer replaces the canonical PRO app as a whole. After the new signed app is verified, it removes unmodified, signed older PRO copies from Applications and temporary Broadcast-driver leftovers. Running copies, newer builds, AXIOM LITE, music, projects, caches and saved installer downloads are preserved.

previous_release_features.title: Faster Library Import
previous_release_features.brief: Start browsing while track details finish.
previous_release_features.description: AXIOM PRO uses Lite's improved import approach: index music paths first, then finish track details in the background. Existing AXIOM corrections remain preserved. Original music stays unchanged.

previous_release_features.title: Record Vault Loading
previous_release_features.brief: Watch your records fly into the crate.
previous_release_features.description: The approved music-loading animation uses steady smoke, a gently pulsing green crate outline and flying records at your selected speed, with a solid dark panel over the dimmed app.

previous_release_features.title: Redesigned DJ Exports
previous_release_features.brief: Serato blue and djay orange.
previous_release_features.description: Name your Serato crate or djay playlist in the redesigned screens, then see a matching completion image and the actual exported name. Existing export verification and safety checks remain.

previous_release_features.title: Installed Build Details
previous_release_features.brief: See exactly which beta is installed.
previous_release_features.description: Settings shows AXIOM PRO 1.0.3 BETA and the exact installed build number. The original splash design and content are preserved, with version and build labels updated. Checking for an update does not replace installed details with the available update's identity. The original Pro welcome screen stays in Night Mode even when the cockpit uses Day Mode.

previous_release_features.title: Performance and Compact Live Assist
previous_release_features.brief: A clearer track desk and more room for your DJ software.
previous_release_features.description: Steel Currently Playing retains readable metadata and a real source waveform. Live Assist uses a smaller laptop-aware window, slimmer controls, neutral Half/Double Time until selected, matching Serato blue or djay orange branding, grouped selected-crate recommendations first and Library underneath. Observed played songs and versions remain excluded throughout the session.

previous_release_features.title: Smart Era Batch Fixes
previous_release_features.brief: Drag to select songs, or accept every suggested era in one click.
previous_release_features.description: Smart Era Audit keeps its action bar visible while scrolling. Select All and Untick All manage the list, Fix Selected Eras changes only your selection, and Accept & Fix All applies all suggested eras in the current results. Rows without a suggestion stay pending. Every batch has an Undo receipt; original years and source music stay unchanged.
